proposed_fix.description: Conditionally scale connection and thread pools to resolve inbound call latency while maintaining zero error rates.
steps: Verify current connection and thread pool utilization metrics for recommendationservice to confirm saturation.
If utilization exceeds 80%, submit a config map update to increase pool limits by 2x for on-call review and explicit approval.
Upon human approval, apply the config map and trigger a graceful reload of the recommendationservice pods.
Monitor recommendationservice_latency-90 for 5 minutes; if latency does not improve, immediately proceed to rollback.
preconditions: Confirm no memory pressure or OOM kills are occurring on recommendationservice pods.
Verify upstream dependencies are stable and not causing thread blocking.
Ensure a backup of the current configuration is stored for immediate rollback.
proposed_fix.rollback: Revert the config map to the previous pool limits and trigger a graceful reload of the recommendationservice pods.
